reviews.author: CinemaSerf
reviews.content: “My father had a small farm on the outskirts of Yugoslavia…” Sadly that rather sums up the standard of the writing and just about everything else in this formulaic extension of the "Footsoldier" series. Now that "Kenny" (Josh Myers) really has ended up as butcher's meat, furious best mate "Tait" (Craig Fairbrass) has sworn vengeance on "Fisher" (Andrew Loveday) and his henchmen. That takes him, and "Sam" (Jamie Foreman) to Ibiza where they find themselves embroiled in a gun-running enterprise run by rogue Royal Marine colonel "Sullivan" (Tamer Hassan) with the help of his battle-scarred associate "Sergio" (Leo Gregory). It turns out that the Ibiza tourist board might have their legitimate cause for complaint too as not only are bodies piling up like last night's used condoms, the CIA (Ross McCall) is working with the local police on the trail of the menacing "Sullivan" and the enigmatic "Isabella" (Vanessa Bauer) is whizzing about the island on her black motor cycle with her own axe to grind, too. It's set in the mid-nineties and is brutal, after a fashion - but the formula is already very tired and here the lack of budget makes the whole thing look cheap and not very cheerful. There are plenty of pyrotechnics towards the end to liven it up, but Fairbrass is no Jason Statham and that lack of on-screen charisma extends to an entire cast who might all be better off swimming with the fishes after what felt like an overlong and very episodic couple of hours riddled with plot holes and implausible frying pan to fire scenarios. It'll be fine on the telly but I know it'll be like the others from this franchise - I'l never remember it.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Pat Tate travels to Ibiza to avenge a friend's murder, stumbling into a dangerous web of arms traffickers, mercenaries, and the CIA.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Seeking vengeance for his friend's murder, Pat Tate journeys to Ibiza, Spain. His quest for justice soon intertwines with a perilous conflict involving international arms traffickers, ruthless mercenaries, and the covert operations of the CIA. Tate finds himself in a deadly situation, battling multiple dangerous factions while trying to achieve his personal retribution.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: After the brutal murder of his close friend, Pat Tate, driven by a thirst for revenge, heads to the sun-drenched but treacherous island of Ibiza. His initial mission is to track down and punish those responsible for the heinous crime. However, Tate's focused pursuit of retribution quickly plunges him into a much larger and more dangerous world than he anticipated. He uncovers a complex web of illicit activities, finding himself caught between powerful arms traffickers who control vast criminal networks. Adding to the peril, highly trained and merciless mercenaries are also operating on the island, complicating Tate's every move. Further escalating the stakes, the secretive and influential CIA becomes involved, suggesting a deeper, geopolitical dimension to the conflict. Tate must navigate this deadly tripartite struggle, utilizing his street smarts and brutal efficiency to survive while never losing sight of his ultimate goal: to avenge his fallen friend amidst the chaos of international intrigue and violence.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: In 'Rise of the Footsoldier: Retribution,' the hardened criminal Pat Tate embarks on a personal mission of vengeance, traveling to the Spanish island of Ibiza after a close friend is brutally murdered. What begins as a straightforward quest for justice quickly devolves into a complex and dangerous entanglement. Tate finds himself inadvertently caught in a deadly conflict involving powerful and ruthless international arms traffickers. This already volatile situation is further complicated by the presence of highly skilled and dangerous mercenaries, who operate with their own agendas on the island. Adding another layer of intrigue and peril, the clandestine operations of the CIA become intertwined with the unfolding events, suggesting a much larger, global conspiracy at play. As Tate navigates this perilous landscape, he must confront multiple formidable enemies while attempting to achieve his singular goal of exacting revenge for his friend, all amidst a backdrop of escalating violence and international espionage.
